title: Stop charging me
body:
I’ve been asking for MONTHS to cancel my subscription.
Again and again I’m told “yes, it’s cancelled”, “don’t worry”, “it will stop” — and yet every single month they keep charging me 79$.

This is not a mistake. This is ongoing, repeated behavior.
Customer support does not actually solve anything — only empty promises while the charges continue.

It feels dishonest and exhausting, and frankly like a scam.
If you value ytransparency and basic respect for users, stay away from this app.
author: Groooman

title: Scam during cancelation
body:
Well, probably app is OK somehow, even I didn’t find it useful.

But their cancellation policy is tricky and misleading. However very well covered legally.

How this app is misleading customers: when I open the "cancel subscription" menu, it forwarded me to my apple subscription without mentioning that I need to send any email. So, I cancel my subscription and was surprised by the next charge of 67$.
When contacted support I was rejected for refund with explanation - you didn’t sent email to our support to cancel the subscription.
author: YaakovP

title: Terrible app!
body:
The interface is awful, and it’s not easy to use. Made it really hard to stick to it everyday.
But the worst part is the cancellation. It’s important to cancel on your own, you have to contact the support team through email.
There is no where to look at your renewal date or the amount of payment after the initial purchase.
I only found out about the renewal after they billed me, and they wouldn’t refund me. 
I have never seen such awful service.
Beware.
